title: HubSpot CRM search returns 400 once paging passes 10,000 results
symptoms: HTTP 400 when after is 10000 or higher
Full sync stops at exactly 10,000 records
Same query works again from after=0
cause: Every CRM search query is capped at 10,000 total results, and asking for a page past that cap is rejected. The after cursor cannot walk further no matter how many records match.
fix: Page with a keyset instead of the cursor: sort ascending by hs_object_id, remember the last id, and start a new query with hs_object_id GT that id whenever you near the cap. For full exports use the list or batch read endpoints instead of search.
affected: HubSpot CRM search endpoints (v3 and date-based 2026-09), all tiers, as of 2026-10
